findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_agent, update_agent, create_share, list_shares, configure_share, update_skill, test_skill_trigger, add_knowledge_file, test_planner_trigger, search_agent4_docs, list_end_users, get_end_user, list_user_sessions, create_storyline · Private data: list_mcp_servers, create_share, list_shares, configure_share, set_custom_domain, test_skill_trigger, create_knowledge_base, add_knowledge_text, add_knowledge_file, build_knowledge_index, get_knowledge_index, patch_knowledge_index, test_planner_trigger, usage_stats, list_end_users, get_end_user, list_user_sessions · Public sink: create_share, configure_share, set_pwa_branding, test_skill_trigger, add_knowledge_file, build_knowledge_index, list_end_users, get_end_user, upsert_page_context, create_storyline, publish_storyline · Destructive: update_agent, configure_share, update_skill, test_skill_trigger, patch_knowledge_index, test_planner_trigger, create_storyline, update_storyline.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_agent, update_agent, create_share, list_shares, configure_share, update_skill, test_skill_trigger, add_knowledge_file, test_planner_trigger, search_agent4_docs, list_end_users, get_end_user, list_user_sessions, create_storyline · Private data: list_mcp_servers, create_share, list_shares, configure_share, set_custom_domain, test_skill_trigger, create_knowledge_base, add_knowledge_text, add_knowledge_file, build_knowledge_index, get_knowledge_index, patch_knowledge_index, test_planner_trigger, usage_stats, list_end_users, get_end_user, list_user_sessions · Public sink: create_share, configure_share, set_pwa_branding, test_skill_trigger, add_knowledge_file, build_knowledge_index, list_end_users, get_end_user, upsert_page_context, create_storyline, publish_storyline · Destructive: update_agent, configure_share, update_skill, test_skill_trigger, patch_knowledge_index, test_planner_trigger, create_storyline, update_storyline

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
